free_text_notes.physician_note: 75-year-old woman with CAD s/p PCI, hypertension, admitted 5/15 with acute on chronic HFrEF exacerbation with volume overload. Transitioned from IV to oral diuretic yesterday; weight stable. 5/20 11:45: Symptomatic hypotension (84/50) this morning after dose increase; reassessing. The patient had a fractured wrist five years ago that healed completely. No ongoing treatment is needed and this does not affect the current plan. A routine review of the patient's long-term conditions was completed by the attending physician. No new diagnoses were made and no changes to ongoing management were recommended.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Slept well overnight. Voiding without difficulty. Still waiting on pharmacy to finish the medication reconciliation.
